name: Moirefield
description: Two fields at nearly the same pitch, so where they agree and disagree becomes the pattern.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%) 0 0 / 14.3% 14.3%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%) 0 0 / 14.3% 14.3%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%) 0 0 / 15.4% 15.4%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%) 0 0 / 15.4% 15.4%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
